newsitem.title: USA: Central Newspapers buys job fair firm.
newsitem.headline: Central Newspapers buys job fair firm.

text.p: Central Newspapers Inc, through its Westech group of companies, said it acquired the assets of Target Career Fairs, a Boston-based company that organizes job fairs for the high-tech industry.
Terms of the all-cash transaction were not disclosed but the company indicated that it expects no dilution in its per share earnings as a result of the acquisition
Target Career Fairs has annual sales volume of approximately $3 million.
Central Newspapers is a media company that publishes daily, Sunday and weekly newspapers.
